label: Enable Arc Converter
description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

label: Auto-disassemble new weapons
description: Only process weapons newly added to V's inventory. Existing weapons are never scanned.

label: Tier 1 (including + variants)
description: Automatically dismantle newly acquired, eligible Tier 1 weapons. Iconic, quest, equipped and crafted weapons remain protected.

label: Tier 2 (including + variants)
description: Automatically dismantle newly acquired, eligible Tier 2 weapons. Iconic, quest, equipped and crafted weapons remain protected.

label: Tier 3 (including + variants)
description: Automatically dismantle newly acquired, eligible Tier 3 weapons. Iconic, quest, equipped and crafted weapons remain protected.

label: Tier 4 (including + variants)
description: Automatically dismantle newly acquired, eligible Tier 4 weapons. Iconic, quest, equipped and crafted weapons remain protected.

label: Tier 5 (including + variants)
description: Automatically dismantle newly acquired, eligible Tier 5 weapons. Iconic, quest, equipped and crafted weapons remain protected.

label: Automatically craft ammunition
description: Use vanilla crafting and components to replenish ammunition for the currently equipped weapon.

label: Craft when reserve below (%)
description: Craft one vanilla recipe batch when ammunition falls below this percentage of its capacity. Never exceed the game's ammo limit.

label: Automatically sell junk for eddies
description: Sell ordinary junk and jewelry anywhere, using normal game selling prices. Includes junk already in the backpack. Quest and protected items are skipped.
